item.title: Building a Local AI Interviewer
item.description: An open-source AI interviewer for practising with your own resume and job description. Explore conversational interview sessions with local language models, real-time speech, adaptive questioning, evidence-based feedback, and lifelike avatars—from browser-based WebGPU to GPU-powered photoreal animation. Built to make interview practice more personal, private, and accessible.
